'''Seafoam Pudding''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. One can be purchased for {{Price|5000}} from the shop at the [[Dance of the Moonlight Jellies]] festival each year. One Seafoam Pudding is part of the iridium tier reward on the 12th and 13th for the [[SquidFest]] festival, assuming the player already earned [[The Art O' Crabbing]] before from the festival. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] turtle with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|300}}.

==Tailoring==
Seafoam Pudding is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Mineral Dog Jacket]]. [[File:Mineral Dog Jacket.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
